description: People the user has not written to in a while, quietest first, with the date of the last thing they sent. Use when a skill needs to know who has gone quiet rather than to rank who is worth contacting: which clients have drifted, who is overdue a note, has anyone been silent since a given point. Judged on sent mail, so it measures what the user did rather than what arrived. `days` sets the line; the default is six months, which is the corpus's dormancy line rather than a tuned one.

days.description: Quiet for at least this many days. Default 182.

name: quiet_contacts
title: Who has gone quiet
